body: PR #2739 (agy/task-1737) has a rework pushed at 170de75978 and is ready for re-review. Summary: main merged in; the #[path] test module is now formatted; the bash-hook test is #[cfg(unix)] and uses test_exec::write_executable (two ratchets that the fmt failure had been hiding); Minor 1: a StatusChange row gets the commit's authority only when its own from->to transition is gated (new test covers two specs in one batch commit); Minor 2: history_cache puts the trailer block after %s behind %x1d and parses with splitn(4) (new test covers a tab inside a trailer value). The cosmetic item (a rendering test) is not done. check-ci-fast passes 30/30; clippy will first run in CI.
